summary: Redwire Corp filed a Form 8-K under Items 5.07 and 8.01 reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The filing discloses voting outcomes for four proposals: election of Class II directors, ratification of KPMG as independent auditor, advisory approval of executive compensation, and the frequency of future advisory votes. Shareholders elected directors Reggie Brothers, Michael Greene, and Dorothy D. Hayes, ratified the auditor, approved compensation on a non-binding basis, and selected a one-year frequency for future advisory votes. This is a routine meeting disclosure with no special-situation elements such as M&A, activist campaigns, or restructuring.
